issue.title: Complete optional authenticated Plex sandbox checks when local API access is available
issue.description: Evidence: bob-cli-8v.2 notes #1-#4; final probe sudo-8c36b7d1-7f7b-4c80-a0a2-fc9f427eba39 and client answer gate 3d9d9a55-415a-44b3-9085-9c4d5bdf75a5. The user answered Played successfully to forced lower-quality tailnet playback, so that fallback itself is complete; do not reopen it merely for absent client details. No claim that this proved NVENC or codec download. Tailnet commit d95f153 preserves the probe and accurate N/A table. Do not enable DLNA, change hardware preferences, provision tokens, start Plex, or override as_found without appropriate authorization. Size large because acceptable authentication provisioning/access and timing for another live validation need planning. This optional validation scope is distinct from landing the accepted sandbox in bob-cli-8t.

task_type_fields.proposal: When authorized authenticated local Plex API access is available, run the existing sandbox validation procedure to exercise library refresh/scan, server-side forced lower-quality transcode with explicit NVENC attribution when supported, codec download and updater status. Record client, selected resolution and hardware evidence; restore the captured run state. Reuse the committed tailnet probes and validation report.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-8v plan explicitly accepts checks documented as N/A with reasons. The missing .LocalAdminToken and disabled DLNA predate this sandbox work. Completed gates prove namespace isolation, unchanged library counts and successful client playback; absent credentials do not demonstrate a sandbox defect. New credential provisioning or preference changes require a separate decision.

issue.creation_reason: Consolidates bob-cli-8v.2 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes #1 and #2. The approved epic accepts documented N/A checks; fuller authenticated feature evidence is optional follow-up, not a reproduced sandbox regression.

payload.description: Optional authenticated follow-up retains N/A coverage after the approved sandbox acceptance
